overall: Checker is clean (244/244 items, 73/73 tokens) and the class calls are sound; exclusives (demort, ffindor, Hogwarts, Malfoy, Weasley, Voldemort, umbledore, Snape, Rowling, Dumbledore, therin, otts) are justified. Main neutrality problems: concept addresses used as distractors in the Sherlock item, Sirius items that a fan solves via the dog connection, Grindelwald and Rowena items that name concept characters, and mild hints in Gryphon anatomy and Remus/she-wolf. Several items do not hinge on the token (Farley Granger->Hitchcock, Hermione->Menelaus/Neoptolemus/'Exit pursued by a bear', Brian Hyland bikini), and a few have giveaways (Grinnell Glacier, 'manga and anime', 'Eighth Doctor', 'health potions', 'Severan', absurd Draco/dragons distractors). Obscurity for a 2B model is the other recurring issue (Cedric Gibbons, Grinnell/Grinling, Quirinus/Quirino, Septimius Severus' birthplace and death, Hogtown, thwarts, Madam Mim, Gerald Gardner, warlock etymology). Across tokens many facts repeat (Gandalf x3, the 'wizard = expert' idiom x4, Hogmanay/hogwash/Hog motorcycle twice each, Salem twice, KitKat and Ivanhoe twice); diversify. For thin tokens (Ginny, Hermione, Severus, Cedric) prefer fewer solid items over obscure fillers, noted in 'note'.
